## ResolveArgv0Options.embeddedCommandInterpreters property

The shell interpreters whose `-c` operand is reported as an `'embedded-command'`<!-- -->. Defaults to [DEFAULT\_EMBEDDED\_COMMAND\_INTERPRETERS](./sh-analysis.default_embedded_command_interpreters.md)<!-- -->. Pass a replacement array to add or drop interpreters; an empty array disables the behavior, so every interpreter resolves as an ordinary effective command.

Validated at the [resolveArgv0()](./sh-analysis.resolveargv0.md) boundary like [ResolveArgv0Options.transparentWrappers](./sh-analysis.resolveargv0options.transparentwrappers.md)<!-- -->: the table must be an array. A non-array value (including `null`<!-- -->) or malformed entry throws [ShAnalyzeInvalidWrapperSpecError](./sh-analysis.shanalyzeinvalidwrapperspecerror.md)<!-- -->; only `undefined` uses defaults.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly embeddedCommandInterpreters?: readonly EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec[];
```
